title: Bash Mod
description: This mod adds a new creature called Bash to the game, along with its variant named Lil Bash.
body:
This mod adds a new creature called Bash to the game, along with its variant named Lil Bash.

![Bash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7473d2d6775f1e211e71d76a19928dc590a543d.png)

Don’t be fooled by Bash’s innocent, cat-like appearance — it is actually making very evil plans about you. By eliminating it, you can cleanse your world of its presence. In return, you will obtain Bash Hair, which can be used to craft powerful armor sets.

![Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/89ff3d233ad34e29c535c24f44aa2de405583346.png)

Alternatively, you can stop Lil Bash from growing up and being led down a dark path. When you encounter a Lil Bash, feed it using pet food to tame it.

![Lil Bash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1f5a3a943b82693113be0c71cd3605a1fe1aded.png)

To craft the food, you need to create a Food Bowl using three Cobblestones, similar to crafting a bowl. Then, using a crafting table, place raw fish or raw mutton into the Food Bowl.

![Bowl Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4eba74d2f2ec3cb6746d3aeafbcbe507c5570737.png)
![Fish](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccc16bc2f417486c95bafc53744428c7d5bf2a89.png)
![Mutton](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c50c7e4d6743d8d79725d02554ca34530835f8b5.png)
